title: common
description: Shared definitions of the filing contract v1, the JSON of `cpa filing ... --json` and `cpa project ls --json` (docs/23-mac-inbox.md §3.2, §3.3). Unknown fields are always allowed; pattern follows ECMA-262 ($ matches only at the end). Only keywords the WhisperWoof validator knows are used (check_filing.KEYWORDS).

monoId.description: A recording session id: EEEEEEE-BBBBB-SSSS in upper-case Crockford base32 (protocol v0 common#/$defs/monoId). Commands accept it in any case.

filing.description: The filing state (docs/23 §2.2). Not called `state`: MCP list_recordings uses state for the transcription.

deviceId.description: HMAC-SHA256(id_key, "dev|" + dev), first 6 bytes in hex. Never the device's own id (its factory MAC address); one key per Mac, so two Macs' ids cannot be joined.

safeText.description: Passed through display_safe(): no C0, DEL, C1 (U+0080-009F), U+2028 / U+2029, bidirectional controls (U+202A-202E, U+2066-2069) or a lone surrogate (U+D800-DFFF: half an emoji; a reader matching with the u flag sees a pair as one code point).

name.description: A project or Mac name: 1-24 UTF-8 bytes where it is stored, so at most 24 characters here.

queueItem.description: A queue item made from a recording by `cpa filing hand` (docs/23 §3.4), or null. intent todo or spawn (to be started as a session from the device board, always in plan mode); open until it is spawned or done.
